claim.statement: Alerts and failed or unknown-outcome job runs are delivered to configured webhook destinations (generic HTTP, Slack, PagerDuty), optionally HMAC-SHA256 signed, with 3 retries.

sources.quote: Webhooks deliver them, optionally signed with HMAC-SHA256
failed deliveries are retried 3 times with backoff (1s, 5s, 25s)
the digest is sent as `X-Mayo-Signature-256: sha256=<hex>`

claim.measurable: Point [[alerts.destinations]] at a local HTTP listener; trigger an alert (cpu fault, node-pressure) and a failing job; verify the body, the X-Mayo-Signature-256 HMAC over it, severity filtering, retries at 1 s, 5 s, 25 s after a 500, and one job_run_failed per run not per task. Evaluate whether a user can add rules (docs - they cannot).
claim.gap: The user manual only shows type = "webhook"; Slack and PagerDuty destination types appear only in docs/design/metrics-mayo.md (lines 17, 43, 225). Custom alert rules are not supported (manual: "You can't define your own rules yet.").
